nodes.label: Logo Banco do Brasil (image/logo_bb.png)
nodes.rationale: Square corporate brand emblem of Banco do Brasil (stored as JPEG with .png extension) featuring the deep institutional blue geometric interlaced monogram and corner parallelogram accents centered on a solid bright yellow background. Establishes the corporate blue (#262DA7) and highlight yellow (#FAFD00) identity codified in guia_estilo.md and visually adapted into the bottom-left emblem of image/geo.png.
